steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ, matching the case's Event Type change.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.
Apply the available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is rendered.
Add the CYLINDER product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Choose the delivery location specified by the case.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFQ create screen, open Participants or Invite Vendor, choose the option to invite a new vendor, enter a valid QA vendor email while leaving the vendor name empty, submit the invitation, and stop when the screen shows the refusal 'Please enter a valid name'

steps.note: Perform the manual new-vendor invitation flow, which has no dedicated catalog action for entering an email with an empty name.
